messages:
Maria (FinOps): Heads-up — we need to finalize the staged rollout for Price Sheet C by EOD Monday. Can product/eng confirm gating and grandfathering lists?
Jon (Product): On it. Are we still doing A/B (10/90) vs. 50/50? I thought execs wanted a conservative start.
Sophia (RevOps): Execs approved 10/90 canary. We must preserve legacy credits for accounts created before 2025-01-01. Full list is in the cohort GSheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/pricing-cohorts (view-only).
Alex (Engineering): For telemetry, I'll enable per-customer tagging and route metrics to the pricing dashboard. Need the final cohort SQL to lock it in. Current draft query:```
SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE created_at < '2025-01-01' AND status = 'active';
```
Maria (FinOps): Good. Also need to confirm billing preview run — does the price change cause proration spikes or credit churn? @billing-bot can we run a preview for the sample canary cohort?
billing-bot: Invoice preview job queued for cohort 'canary-10pct' — job id 20250315-42. ETA ~15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Jon (Product): Thanks. Also propose a rollback window: automatic rollback if invoice anomalies > 0.5% of affected accounts within first 48 hours. Thoughts?
Sophia (RevOps): Approved. Also request that grandfathered accounts keep previous effective rate until their next renewal after 90 days. That minimizes surprise invoices.
Alex (Engineering): Ops question: when we flip routing to the new price, will Dedicated/Private tenants be excluded? We should ensure Dedicated capacity and private deployments are on a separate rollout path.
Maria (FinOps): Yes — exclude Dedicated and Private from the canary. We'll coordinate Dedicated via AE handoffs. Also need legal sign-off on TOS notice wording — @Jon can you follow up with Legal and copy me?
Jon (Product): Will do. I’ll ping Legal and post the confirmation here. If the preview looks clean, target start for the canary is Thu 09:00 PST.
billing-bot: Invoice preview complete: 10,342 accounts processed, sample anomalies 0.12% (within threshold). Detailed report: https://redwood.internal/reports/20250315-42.
Maria (FinOps): This looks good. Action items: Alex — enable tagging + exclude Dedicated/Private; Jon — legal follow-up + notify partners; Sophia — publish final GSheet with cohort and grandfathering flags. Reconvene 10:00 Thu to approve flip. :white_check_mark:
